page.overview:
Who is Astral birds?

Astral birds are unnamed winged creatures from Astral World in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL anime.

When Yuma Tsukumo journeyed to Astral World to find Astral, Eliphas attempted to dispose of him before he could do so. At one point, Eliphas released a large flock of these birds, which tore through the wing of the plane of "Goblindbergh", which Yuma had been using as transportation. The plane crashed in pieces to the ground, but Rainbow Kuriboh saved Yuma.
